  • query_topics (the extracted topics to check)
  • reference_topics (the gold-standard topics)

For each query topic:
  1. Normalize case, ignore trivial punctuation, and treat plural/singular forms as equivalent.
  2. Allow fuzzy and semantic matches: consider shared stems, domain overlap, thematic similarity,
     synonyms, and derivational variants.
  3. Expand known acronyms when matching.
  4. If a query topic broadly or semantically aligns with any reference topic, count it as a match.
  5. Use domain knowledge and policy/legal context where applicable.
  6. Return true with a concise reason if matched; otherwise false with an explanation.

Return *only* a JSON object with one key "results", whose value is an array of
objects in the same order as query_topics. Each object must have exactly:
  {
    "reason": <string>,
    "verdict": true or false
  }
Do not include any extra text or formatting.
